author: Dabbler Platform contributors
name: Dabbler CRUD Service Slice
description: Item template that scaffolds a CRUD service interface, EF-Core-backed implementation, and POST /query controller for a single entity using the Dabbler.Api.Querying transport contract (GridQueryRequest/Response + QBE helper). Generates Services/I{Entity}Service.cs, Services/{Entity}Service.cs, and Controllers/{EntityPlural}Controller.cs. Pre-stage the EF entity (e.g., Customer.cs) and the DTO ({Entity}Dto.cs) before invoking; the template emits the service trio around them.

entity.description: Entity class name (PascalCase). Drives interface/class/file names and the singular-form references inside the controller.

entityPlural.description: Entity plural class name (PascalCase). Drives the controller class/file name and the DbSet property name. Auth-policy names are derived from --auth-policy-prefix (which defaults to --entity), NOT from this value.

apiNamespace.description: Namespace for the generated service and controller (typically the API project root namespace, e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api').

dtoNamespace.description: Namespace containing {Entity}Dto (typically the Shared project's DTO namespace, e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared.DTOs').

entityNamespace.description: Namespace containing the EF entity class (e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared.Models').

dbContextType.description: DbContext class name (e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeDbContext'). The generated service injects this type.

pkType.description: Primary-key CLR type for the entity. Defaults to 'int'. Use 'long', 'Guid', etc. for non-int PKs.

authPolicyPrefix.description: Prefix used to derive the [DabblerEndpointAuthorize] policy strings on the generated controller. Defaults to the entity value via the coalesce generator below — e.g., entity='Supplier' yields QuerySupplier / GetSupplier / CreateSupplier / UpdateSupplier / DeleteSupplier. Override to align policy names with an existing authorization convention (e.g., 'BackofficeSupplier').

schema.description: Optional path to a .dabbler-entity.json schema file. Reserved for the dabbler-crud-page template (which enumerates fields for grid columns / form fields / filter config). The service template accepts the parameter for symmetry but does not consume it: the generic QBE helper handles per-property filter/sort dispatch at runtime, so no per-property service code is emitted.
